WITH f AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) exstaff_net,
  count(DISTINCT receipt_id) all_rc, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) exstaff_rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
 WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(receipts) rpt_rc, count(*) AS n_days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.store_id, f.all_net, f.exstaff_net, r.rpt_gross, r.rpt_ret, r.rpt_net, f.all_rc, f.exstaff_rc, r.rpt_rc, r.n_days

SELECT 'ret' src, CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN s.store_id ELSE 0 END grp, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nid, sum(r.refund_net) amt, sum(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan, count(DISTINCT r.reason_code) reasons
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', CASE WHEN store_id>=900 THEN store_id ELSE 0 END, count(*), count(DISTINCT business_date), sum(net_sales), sum(receipts), sum(returns_net)::BIGINT FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nontrading', 0, count(*), count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), sum(f.net_amount), 0, 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND NOT d.is_trading_day AND f.channel_id=1
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sales AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id <> 999),
ret AS (
 SELECT r.* FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id <> 999)
SELECT (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM sales) gross_net, (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM ret) refunds,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM sales) receipts,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) FROM sales) dup_lines,
 (SELECT max(net_amount) FROM sales) max_line, (SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE net_amount IS NULL) null_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM sales GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_key)>1)) multi_store_receipts,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount)/count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM sales) atv_before_returns,
 ((SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM sales) - (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM ret)) / (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM sales) atv_net,
 (SELECT sum(gross_amount)/count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM sales) atv_gross
